resources.string: Sign-in server, DNS, Taildrop folder and updates
The local panel did not start in time. Refresh status and try again.
Off: the panel opens inside this app; press back to return. On: it opens in your default browser.
Use your Headscale base URL, or leave blank for Tailscale. HTTPS is recommended; HTTP is unencrypted. Changing servers disconnects the current network and requires registration with the new server.
Connect to %1$s? This can disconnect your current network. Complete registration on the selected server afterward.
Enter an HTTP or HTTPS server URL without credentials, query, or fragment.
Open the sign-in link and complete registration on your server, then refresh status.
The server preference was saved. If sign-in is still pending, open the full panel to complete registration, then refresh status.

Automatically saves received files while the module runs. Use a folder under /sdcard/ or /storage/; it will be created if needed. Duplicate names are numbered, never overwritten. On errors, files remain in the private inbox; check Logs and Diagnostic records.
Enter a shared-storage folder such as /sdcard/Download or /storage/emulated/0/Download. Do not use mount roots, empty or . / .. segments, trailing slashes, or control characters.
Enable the module and wait for tailscaled to run before changing sign-in or DNS settings.
Accept the DNS configuration from your tailnet.
Use Tailscale DNS for all apps
Redirects Android port-53 queries to the Tailscale resolver. Turn Android Private DNS off; apps with built-in DoH bypass this.
System-wide DNS is enabled but not applied while the daemon is stopped.
KernelSU has staged module files. Check Active runtime above to see which version is selected; the staged files alone do not mean the runtime needs a reboot.
Apply the staged runtime?\nThe current runtime will stop and switch to the verified staged version. This does not reboot the device.
Downloaded from Tailscale and verified. Applying briefly restarts the service, retaining your login and settings. No device reboot needed.

This bundled engine includes required Android compatibility patches. To keep those patches, update the full module. Official releases are shown for reference only; standalone engine downloads and installation are disabled.
Downloading and verifying; the current service will keep running…
Apply the verified Tailscale engine? The service will restart briefly. Your login and settings will be retained.
Migrate the legacy module identity?\nThe old module must be disabled or removed, both runtimes stopped, and no new identity present. Old files will be kept. Enable separately after migration.
